summary: community.crypto deprecated the false default of get_certificate's asn1_base64 option, which becomes true in 3.0.0.
questions: get_certificate warns about asn1_base64, what should I set?
Will get_certificate output change in community.crypto 3?

answer_card.title: get_certificate asn1_base64 default
answer_card.answer_md: The default of **`asn1_base64`** in `community.crypto.get_certificate` changes from `false` to **`true`** in 3.0.0. Set it explicitly to avoid the warning and keep stable output.
